request.style: English, female solo voice with warm choir, piano, strings, harp, mood of gentle encouragement and faith, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Consider it nothing but joy, my brothers
When trials of every kind come your way
Testing of your faith produces endurance
Let it finish its work today

[Pre-Chorus]
So that you may be mature and complete
Lacking nothing in the heart
If you lack wisdom, do not fear
Just turn to where the light is start

[Chorus]
Ask God, who gives generously to all
Without finding fault, He will not fail
It will be given to him, it will be given to him
Ask in faith, keep your heart from strife

[Verse]
But let him ask in faith, without doubting
For the one who doubts is like a wave
Driven and tossed by the wind
Unstable in all he does and saves

[Chorus]
Ask God, who gives generously to all
Without finding fault, He will not fail
It will be given to him, it will be given to him
Ask in faith, keep your heart from strife

[Bridge]
Such a person should not expect to receive anything
From the Lord, for double-minded minds are blind
Do not be tossed about by the wind
Stand firm in the truth you will find

[Chorus]
Ask God, who gives generously to all
Without finding fault, He will not fail
It will be given to him, it will be given to him
Ask in faith, keep your heart from strife

[Outro]
It will be given to him
Ask God, and be still
